description: Places and manages orders on 16 crypto exchanges and on MetaTrader 5 broker accounts from one hosted MCP connection. 20 tools: portfolio and position reads, order simulation, order placement and modification, closing positions, and a signed receipt for each action. New connections use a paper scope with a $5,000 virtual balance; the live scope needs a separate key behind a second factor. Risk rules (required stop-loss, user-set limits) are evaluated on the server. MT5 accounts run on terminals operated by AlgoVesta, so no EA or VPS is needed on the user side.
